title: 第九章 误会第十章 欠账
content_zh:
“咦！这么不是琪莉米丝大婶，而是男的，我以前没有见过他，难道他是留进来的小偷！”躲在大衣柜里的颜铁龙从大衣柜门缝中看到打开自己以前房间门，是一位自己不认识的男性就小声嘀咕道。
颜铁龙看到英俊年轻人重新关上门，小心翼翼的从大衣柜里走出来，神情露出一丝兴奋小声嘀咕道：“呵呵，小子算你倒霉，就拿你当琪莉米丝大婶见面礼！”。
颜铁龙小心的打开房门，刚将脑袋刚刚露出门口，突然他眼睛看到一个不断放大的拳头。
颜铁龙想要避开拳头，可惜已经来不及了，最后颜铁龙右眼直接被拳头击中，让他右眼出现黑紫大眼圈。
原来英俊的年轻人打开颜铁龙房间，发现地板上有人的走动痕迹，而他却没有看到人，为了不打草惊蛇就退出房间，在门外伏击他以为是小偷颜铁龙。
事情果然如英俊年轻人所料，当颜铁龙铁打开门并鬼鬼祟祟的将脑袋伸出来，英俊年轻人他根本不给颜铁龙反应的机会直接一拳击中颜铁龙右眼上。
颜铁龙右眼被打的十分难受，但是他忍着右眼难受情况直接一拳回击袭击他的人。
英俊年轻人有点意外颜铁龙没有被自己打倒，而且对颜铁龙的一拳回击，他直接防守颜铁龙的一拳。
只是可惜英俊年轻人错估了颜铁龙的力量，直接被颜铁龙一拳击退，并撞到走廊对面墙壁。
“力量很大啊！”还算英俊年轻人感受防御颜铁龙攻击的手臂传了一阵阵微疼感，神情变认真说道，然后举起右手向颜铁龙攻击过去。
同时颜铁龙暗骂一声：“靠！居然袭击本大爷，本大爷让你知道什么是花儿红啊。”，并向对手一拳。
当二人的拳头相碰之时，英俊年轻人被拳头传来的力量直接退了几步，而颜铁龙只是退了一步看到对手后退比自己远就自得的笑着说道：“哈哈，敢跟我比力量真是找死，也不看看你的对手是谁！”。
英俊年轻人挥挥了右手减轻疼痛感，当他听到颜铁龙的话直接把出自己腰间的铁剑，砍向颜铁龙。
“靠！肉搏不行，居然把剑，真是耍赖皮啊！”颜铁龙狼狈躲过对手劈砍并骂道。
以狼狈的姿态躲过对手几招剑招的颜铁龙急忙把出自己的剑挡住对手的追击，二人的剑相碰产生“乒！”声音。
颜铁龙的力量胜于对手，而英俊年轻人用剑术引导让颜铁龙剑砍中左侧墙壁上，并左一拳击中颜铁龙侧腹。
颜铁龙忍着侧腹疼痛，用剑横扫逼退还算英俊年轻人攻式，让自己重新恢复防守，同时让自己先前暴露弱点消失。
当英俊年轻人快速攻击颜铁龙，颜铁龙一边防守一边嘴巴嘀嘀咕咕着，最后一剑逼开对手，并大喊一声：“风刃！”。
颜铁龙左手形成魔法阵，魔法阵里射出十几道风刃向英俊年轻人，英俊年轻人他用发亮光的铁剑挡住颜铁龙风刃以及躲开一部分风刃，而英俊年轻人避开的风刃直接击破了他身后木窗。
木窗碎片从陈旧旅店二楼飞出到小花园，而刚刚到花园的羽米莉莉被掉落自己眼前的木头碎片吓的尖叫：“啊！！！”。

而陈旧正旅店里的颜铁龙和英俊年轻人二人全神贯注对方，他们不知道很快他们的因为误会导致对战，最后导致颜铁龙一小段时间钱包空空。
“不好了，出事了！要快一点通知米丝婶婶才行。”羽米莉莉吃惊看到陈旧旅店二楼出现不少动静，而且她看到剑直接将墙壁劈出一些缺口这种情况，然后转身向先前柜台跑去。
羽米莉莉跑到柜台，在得知琪莉米丝去了厨房，当她有气喘跑到厨房看到正在做菜的琪莉米丝在跟另一位厨娘大婶聊天，就大声道：“米丝婶婶，不好了，出事了！！”。
正在聊天琪莉米丝突然听到羽米莉莉急切的喊声，停下做菜的动作看向厨房门口，当她看到站在哪里点气喘的羽米莉莉疑惑问道：“羽米莉莉不要急，有话慢慢说。”。
羽米莉莉听到自己婶婶的话就稍微平复了自己的呼吸，然后急切地说道：“米丝婶婶，老房子那里有人在打架，而且老房子已经出现损伤了！”。
“老房子！我记得哪里已经被我设定为禁区，这么会有人去那个地方？”琪莉米丝听到羽米莉莉的话疑惑道。
“米丝婶婶，刚刚颜铁龙大哥回来了，而且他进入老房子里。”羽米莉莉听到自己婶婶的话突然想起颜铁龙进入老房子就说道。
“颜铁龙回来了！这是什么时候的事？”琪莉米丝听到颜铁龙的消息急忙问道。
“恩，就是比米丝婶婶你早一点点。”羽米莉莉回应道。
“库米薇丝，这里就交给你！”琪莉米丝对厨房正在切肉的三十几岁厨娘拜托道。
“好的，老板。”库米薇丝厨娘回应完就接过琪莉米丝工作。
琪莉米丝跟羽米莉莉快速向老房子跑去。
content_en:
"Hey! This is not Aunt Qilimis, but a man. I have never seen him before. Could it be that he is a thief who stayed here?" Yan Tielong, who was hiding in the closet, muttered when he saw through the crack in the closet door that he opened the door to his previous room. It was a man he did not recognize.
Yan Tielong saw the handsome young man close the door again and walk out of the closet cautiously, with a hint of excitement on his face and whispered: "Haha, I think you are unlucky, I will use you as a gift to meet Aunt Qilimis!".
Yan Tielong opened the door carefully, and just when his head came out of the door, his eyes suddenly saw an enlarging fist.
Yan Tielong tried to avoid the fist, but unfortunately it was too late. In the end, Yan Tielong was hit directly in the right eye by the fist, causing a big black and purple circle in his right eye.
It turned out that the handsome young man opened Yan Tielong's room and found traces of someone walking on the floor, but he did not see the person. In order not to alert the snake, he exited the room and ambushed Yan Tielong outside the door, thinking he was the thief.
Things turned out as the handsome young man expected. When Yan Tielong opened the door and sneakily stuck his head out, the handsome young man didn't give Yan Tielong a chance to react and directly punched Yan Tielong in the right eye.
Yan Tielong's right eye was hit very painfully, but he endured the pain in his right eye and punched back his attacker.
The handsome young man was a little surprised that Yan Tielong was not knocked down by him, and he directly defended Yan Tielong's punch in response to Yan Tielong's punch.
It's a pity that the handsome young man misjudged Yan Tielong's strength and was directly punched back by Yan Tielong and hit the opposite wall of the corridor.
"It's very powerful!" The relatively handsome young man felt a slight pain in his arm that was defending Yan Tielong's attack. His expression turned serious and he said seriously, then he raised his right hand to attack Yan Tielong.
At the same time, Yan Tielong cursed secretly: "Damn! You actually attacked me. I want you to know what Huaerhong is." and punched his opponent.
When the fists of the two collided, the handsome young man took a few steps back due to the power from the fist. Yan Tielong just took a step back and saw his opponent retreating farther than him. He smiled complacently and said: "Haha, if you dare to compete with me in strength, you are looking for death, and you don't even know who your opponent is!".
The handsome young man waved his right hand to relieve the pain. When he heard Yan Tielong's words, he took out the iron sword from his waist and slashed at Yan Tielong.
"Damn! I'm not good at hand-to-hand combat, but I'm using a sword. What a shame!" Yan Tielong cursed as he dodged his opponent's chops in a panic.
Yan Tielong, who had dodged several sword moves from his opponent in an embarrassed manner, quickly drew out his sword to block his opponent's pursuit. The two swords collided, making a "ping!" sound.
Yan Tielong was stronger than his opponent, but the handsome young man used his sword skills to guide Yan Tielong's sword and hit the left wall, and hit Yan Tielong's side with a left punch.
Yan Tielong endured the pain in his flank and used his sword to sweep across the force and return to the handsome young man's attack style, allowing himself to regain his defense and at the same time eliminate his previously exposed weaknesses.
When the handsome young man quickly attacked Yan Tielong, Yan Tielong muttered while defending. With the last sword, he forced his opponent away and shouted: "Wind Blade!".
Yan Tielong formed a magic circle with his left hand. The magic circle fired more than a dozen wind blades at the handsome young man. The handsome young man used his shiny iron sword to block Yan Tielong's wind blades and dodge part of the wind blades. The wind blades that the handsome young man avoided directly broke the wooden window behind him.
The wooden window fragments flew out from the second floor of the old hotel into the small garden, and Yumi Lili, who had just arrived in the garden, was frightened by the wooden fragments falling in front of her eyes and screamed: "Ah!!!".
Yan Tielong and the handsome young man in the Chencheng Hotel were all focused on each other. They didn't know that soon their misunderstanding would lead to a fight, and eventually Yan Tielong's wallet would be empty for a short period of time.
"No, something happened! We need to inform Aunt Mis quickly."OK. "Hami Lily was surprised to see a lot of movement on the second floor of the old hotel, and she saw the sword directly cutting some gaps in the wall, then turned around and ran towards the previous counter.
Yumi Lily ran to the counter and learned that Kirimis had gone to the kitchen. When she was out of breath, she ran to the kitchen and saw Kirimis who was cooking and chatting with another cook. She said loudly: "Aunt Misi, it's bad, something happened! ! ".
While chatting, Kirimis suddenly heard Yumi Lily's urgent shout. She stopped cooking and looked at the kitchen door. When she saw Yumi Lily standing there, panting, she asked doubtfully: "Yumi Lily, don't be anxious, speak slowly if you have anything to say. ".
After hearing her aunt's words, Yumi Lily calmed down her breathing a little, and then said eagerly: "Aunt Misi, there is someone fighting in the old house, and the old house has been damaged! ".
“Old house! I remember where I had set it as a restricted area, so would anyone go to that place? "Qilimis was puzzled when she heard Yumi Lily's words.
"Aunt Misi, Brother Yan Tielong came back just now, and he entered the old house. "Yumi Lily heard her aunt's words and suddenly remembered Yan Tielong entering the old house and said.
"Yan Tielong is back! When did this happen? "Qilimis asked hurriedly after hearing the news about Yan Tielong.
“Well, it’s just a little earlier than Aunt Mis. " Yumi Lily responded.
“Kumiweisi, I’ll leave this to you! "Qilimis asked the cook in her thirties who was cutting meat in the kitchen.
"Okay, boss. "Kumiweisi, the cook, responded and took over Kirimisi's work.
Kirimisi and Yumilili quickly ran towards the old house.
